::: {.project-entry}
### [DIVIDE: Secession Referenda and Interethnic Relations](projects/divide.qmd)

::: {.project-meta}
**PI:** [Oliver Strijbis](https://oliverstrijbis.com/){target="_blank"} &bull; **Funder:** [Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)](https://data.snf.ch/grants/grant/10003605){target="_blank"} &bull; **Institution:** [Franklin Switzerland](https://www.fus.edu/){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.project-summary}
DIVIDE investigates how secession referenda and mechanisms of direct democracy affect interethnic relations, social cohesion, and minority-majority attitudes in divided societies.
:::

::: {.project-entry}
### [Social Networks in the Spanish Civil War](projects/civil-war-networks.qmd)

::: {.project-meta}
**Joint with:** [Sergi Martínez](https://sergimartinez.github.io/){target="_blank"} &bull; **Status:** Work in progress
:::

::: {.project-summary}
Exploring how pre-war social and political networks shaped mobilization, insurgency participation, and violence during the Spanish Civil War (1936&ndash;1939), based on newly digitized individual-level archival data from Navarre.
:::

::: {.project-actions}
<a href="projects/civil-war-networks.qmd" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">Project page <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></a>
<a href="https://giacomolemoli.github.io/uploads/slides/navarra-1936/20260615_SPEIN.html" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" target="_blank"><i class="fa-solid fa-display"></i> Slides (SPEIN 2026)</a>
:::
:::

::: {.project-entry}
### [Interethnic Relations and Clientelism in Kenya](projects/kenya-clientelism.qmd)

::: {.project-meta}
**Joint with:** [Jeremy Horowitz](https://www.jeremy-horowitz.com/){target="_blank"} and [Kristin Michelitch](https://sites.google.com/site/kristinmichelitch/home/){target="_blank"} &bull; **Status:** Working papers available
:::

::: {.project-summary}
Investigating attitudes towards clientelism, partisan bias, and the interaction between ethnic and political identities in Kenya through lab-in-the-field and survey experiments.
:::

::: {.project-actions}
<a href="projects/kenya-clientelism.qmd" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">Project page <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></a>
